about: triage's application mutants (wf10 CONSTRAINTS C4); each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: triage-severity-no-tiebreak
mutants.from: cmp.Then(cmp.Compare(b.Severity, a.Severity), cmp.Then(cmp.Compare(a.Host, b.Host), cmp.Compare(a.Line, b.Line)))
mutants.rule: BySeverity breaks a tie of severity and host by the line (law LineBreaksTies; case ties: the quicksort is not stable).

mutants.name: triage-host-least-severe-first
mutants.rule: ByHost puts the most severe entry of a host first (case host).

mutants.name: triage-host-case-hash
mutants.from: func Hash(_ HostCase, host string) uint64 { maps.Hash(strings.ToLower(host)) }
mutants.to: func maps.Hash(_ HostCase, host string) uint64 { hash(host) }
mutants.rule: HostCase hashes the form its Equal compares (law Hashing.EqualKeysHashEqual; case count).

mutants.name: triage-host-case-sensitive
mutants.from: func Equal(_ HostCase, a string, b string) bool { strings.ToLower(a) == strings.ToLower(b) }
mutants.to: func Equal(_ HostCase, a string, b string) bool { a == b }
mutants.rule: HostCase calls web-1 and WEB-1 one host (case count).
